title: Platformer: engine loop + rendering (canvas, fixed timestep, input)
desc: Child of the platformer epic. Deliverable: projects/platformer/index.html + game.js with the loop and the frame contract: fixed timestep (accumulator, e.g. 1/60 s steps, max 5 catch-up steps per frame), requestAnimationFrame driver, delta clamping, keyboard input mapped to a small state object (left/right/jump), and a render pass that clears and draws the world. ACCEPTANCE: game.js passes node --check; the loop keeps simulation stable when the tab is throttled (state it in the README and show how you verified); no allocations inside the loop (hoist objects/arrays, reuse the state object); a title screen state exists and is reachable. Interface contract for the other children: post the exact shape of the state/player/level objects on the bus in ONE short message before you code, and do not change it afterwards without announcing.
